text: Zara and Leon got engaged in Lisbon last weekend! He proposed on a tram, apparently. Wedding probably over the summer next year, maybe in Leon's home town in Cork. Zara wants something small, he wants everyone. They're doing drinks to celebrate sometime next week, she'll send details. Remind me to get them a bottle of something nice before then.
Remind me to text Adaeze the day before her housewarming to ask what she needs. It's Saturday at 7pm, at the new flat in Walthamstow.
Darius is hosting a dinner for his parents' 40th anniversary at the end of the month. I'm doing dessert.

Agnieszka mentioned her sister Marta is getting married in Kraków in early June. She's maid of honour and already stressed about the speech. Marta's fiancé is Italian, so half the guests won't understand Polish jokes anyway, which I pointed out did not help. She's flying out on the 30th and will be gone ten days. I should send her a good luck message the morning of the wedding.
Karim's birthday drinks are sometime next week, probably Thursday. He said he'd confirm the pub tomorrow morning.
Jonah and Sofia's engagement party has been called off. They split up a fortnight ago. Sofia sounded really flat on the phone, so I should check in on her over the weekend.
Patrick is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the barbecue.
Need to buy a card for Jamal and Zoe's tenth anniversary. It's on the 14th, so post it the week before at the latest.
Ebony invited me to her 30th. Friday the 8th at half 8, rooftop bar near Liverpool Street. Dress code is 'something sparkly'.
Hadiza's wedding was beautiful. Must send her the photos from the ceremony this evening, she asked twice.

Coffee with Xavier. He's thinking of proposing to his girlfriend Lena around Christmas but hasn't bought a ring yet. Wants my opinion on vintage versus new. Lena's mum has a ring from her grandmother that might come to her one day, which complicates things. He also wants to ask her dad first, which I said was sweet but optional. Must check in with him early December to see if he's decided.
Aleksander's leaving do is Wednesday at 6. I'm going straight from work.
Marisol and Pieter are renewing their vows in Cape Town in early March. Twenty-five years! Don't forget to ask about the guest list the week after next.
Dinner at Ifeoma's last night. Her husband Femi cooked jollof and her dog Biscuit tried to steal it twice. They're moving to Leeds over the summer.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday and book a taxi for 6pm.
Abigail is nervous about meeting her fiancé's family for the first time next Sunday. Remind me to message her good luck that morning.
Mai said her parents' ruby anniversary is on 3 November. She's planning a surprise lunch and wants a hand with the slideshow.
Damian couldn't make the housewarming because his little boy had a fever. Hope he's better.
Hemi is learning to make sourdough and has a terrible starter called Doug. Also really into vinyl, mostly seventies soul.
Rebecca and Ben are hosting a games night on the 22nd at 7. Bring snacks, not wine; they've got loads.

Fiona's mum turns 70 sometime at the end of the month and there's a big family party. Fiona is organising the lot and sounds exhausted. Her brother lives in Dubai and isn't helping at all, and her dad keeps changing the guest list. The venue is a cricket club near Guildford. I told her I'd help with decorations on the Saturday morning. Remind me to ring her the evening after to see how it went.
Angela got engaged! Her partner Tobi asked her at the top of Snowdon on Sunday morning. I need to send flowers before Friday.

Rohan is going to Femi's stag in Prague in two weeks. He's dreading it a bit, not a big drinker, and he barely knows the other lads. It's four nights, flying out Thursday morning, with go-karting and a beer bike. He's already said he'll skip the strip club. Meanwhile his own girlfriend Mai has her graduation the following Monday at 11, so he has to be back sober and functional.
Remind me to ring Uncle Patrick the evening before his anniversary dinner. He wants help choosing a restaurant for Auntie Zoe.
Quick one: Zara's dad is retiring at Christmas and she wants to throw him a party in January.
Leon mentioned he'd love a decent pasta machine. Could be a good engagement present for the two of them.
Adaeze's housewarming went really well. I should drop her a thank you note tomorrow, and return the dish she lent me sometime next week.
Sofia Osei, or Sof as everyone calls her, has started a new job at a wedding venue in Surrey. She loves it so far.
Darius said the anniversary dinner is moving to the Saturday instead, 12th at half 7. Same restaurant.

Invite from Agnieszka for a Polish Christmas Eve dinner on the 24th. I said yes. Bring something sweet. She explained there are twelve dishes, no meat, and you wait for the first star before eating. Her partner Jonah is cooking the carp, which apparently lives in the bath for a day first. Their kids are four and six and will be up way past bedtime. Should practise saying something in Polish.

Jamal Shah called. Zoe's grandma passed away on Tuesday, funeral is early next week. They might miss the anniversary trip to Rome. Must remember to send a card to Zoe tomorrow, and ask Jamal later in the week if they need anything.
No plans this weekend for once. Sort the spare room and finally reply to the wedding RSVPs.
Karim and his wife Hadiza have their first wedding anniversary on Thursday. Don't forget to message them that morning.
Ebony's party was cancelled, she's come down with flu. Rescheduling for sometime in December.
Lunch with Xavier and his brother Aleksander. Aleksander has just moved in with his girlfriend in Bristol and they're having a small housewarming on Sunday afternoon. Xavier is going; I might.
Remind me to book the restaurant for our anniversary by Friday. Ask for the table by the window again.

Mai is allergic to shellfish. Hemi is gluten free. Plan the dinner menu around both. Maybe a big risotto with a separate prawn bit for everyone else, or just skip the prawns altogether. Dinner is a week on Saturday at 7 for the five of us, partly to celebrate Mai's promotion. Order the cake on Wednesday and pick it up Saturday afternoon.
Pieter's daughter is getting married in August and he's paying for most of it. He seemed worried about money. Should take him for a pint the week after next and see how he's doing.
Ifeoma's engagement anniversary is tomorrow. Femi has booked a surprise weekend in Bath, so don't say anything to her before Saturday.
Tobi said Angela keeps hinting about a Le Creuset for the new kitchen. Possible engagement gift.

Patrick asked if I'd do a reading at his wedding in early May. I said yes. Need to find something that isn't Corinthians. His fiancée Rebecca loves Mary Oliver, so maybe a poem of hers. The rehearsal is the evening before, at the church in Stoke Newington, and then a dinner at her parents' house. Patrick seemed calm about everything except the weather. Draft something by the end of the month and send it to him.

Rebecca rang this afternoon. Ben's cousin Lena is having her christening party for the baby on Sunday at 2pm, and they've invited me along. I'll drive Rebecca's mum since she doesn't like the motorway. Remind me to pick up a gift for the baby on Saturday.
Damian Walsh is turning 40 at the end of the month. His wife Fiona wants it low key: dinner for six, no speeches. He'd love a good bottle of Rioja.

Hemi and Abigail's wedding date is set: 19 July, at a farm near Hereford. Save the dates going out sometime next week. It's going to be a long weekend thing with camping and a ceilidh on the Saturday night. Hemi's family are flying over from Auckland, about twenty of them, and Abigail is quietly panicking about where they'll all stay. Pencil in the Friday off work. I'm booking the B&B tomorrow evening before they fill up.
Text Rohan on Monday to see how the proposal went. He was planning it for Sunday evening at the restaurant where they had their first date, and he was shaking just talking about it.
Book club at Zara's on Thursday at 8. I'm bringing the wine.
Jonah's been quiet since the breakup. His sister Agnieszka says he's not eating much. I should invite him over for dinner sometime this week.
Dentist moved to Tuesday at 10am. Ask about the whitening before the wedding.
Femi's brother Tobi is the best man and has no idea what to say. He asked me for help with the speech before the stag do on the 2nd.
Adaeze told me she and Karim are thinking of eloping rather than a big wedding. Her family would not be pleased. Keep it quiet.
Leon's birthday is the 30th. Remind me to order the record player the week before so it arrives in time.
Marisol's daughter Zoe just got into Edinburgh to study law. Marisol was beaming. Starts in September.
Darius and his partner Jamal have been together ten years this Friday. They're doing a small dinner at home. I should drop off a bottle that afternoon.
The housewarming at Pieter's was lovely. His cat Pepper hid under the bed the whole night. He's settling in well, loves the area.
Sofia has her final dress fitting on Thursday at 4pm and her mum is coming. She's anxious it won't fit after all the stress. Remind me to call her that evening.
Gym at 7 tomorrow morning, then food shop.
Abigail Brennan, Abi to her friends, works as a florist and is doing the flowers for Angela's wedding.
Got an invite to Zoe and Jamal's anniversary barbecue on the bank holiday Monday. Must reply by the end of the week.
Fiona said her mum's party went brilliantly, about sixty people turned up. Ask her for the photos when she's had a rest.
Ifeoma, Mai and Hadiza are all coming to the hen do in Brighton in early April. Mai's in charge of the cocktail class; Hadiza's booking the house by the end of the month.
